messages:
emma: Noticed a weird failure in the onboarding sampleapp when using the rerank pipeline. Getting different embedding shapes depending on which SDK is used.
josh: What shapes? error logs?
emma: stacktrace from rerank service: `MismatchError: query vector dim 1536 != candidate dim 1024`. Sampleapp uses batched embedding helper.
maya: are you on node or python?
emma: Node 1.12.x in sampleapp docker. Python sample locally shows 1536 vectors, node returns 1024 in the same test harness.
josh: interesting, we recently changed the node batching helper to return "vectors" field for compact shards and to drop trailing zeros. Python still returns the full-dim `embeddings`. Could be a field-name + shape mismatch.
omar: i dug into the node helper: for performance it now does shard-trim where models are quantized to 256-shard dim. It emits condensed vectors and a `shard_meta` header with model_dim:1536, shard_size:256. But downstream rerank expects raw `embeddings` of model_dim length.
ci-bot: :information_source: CI run on sdk-node@1.12.5 shows parity tests failing: embeddings roundtrip.
emma: this explains onboarding breakage: sampleapp posts batched embeddings to /v1/rerank without translating shard format -> server throws mismatch. We should not change wire format without server-side support.
maya: agreed. short-term fix: sampleapp should expand shard vectors back to model_dim by padding zeros before sending to rerank. longer: unify SDK behavior or add a compatibility flag.
josh: also noticed auth/retry gotcha: when SDK refresh token flow retries, we were re-sending the same batch but with different shapes due to lazy-shard creation. That produced duplicate entries and then the dedupe logic collapsed one, shifting indices for rerank.
omar: yeah that was nasty. If retry padded differently you could end up with index skew. Need idempotency keys on batch requests.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: created ticket CI-embed-932 for parity tests and CI failure details.
emma: action items: (1) revert node helper to stable wire shape (josh), (2) add server-side validation that returns friendly error including field name & expected dim (maya), (3) sampleapp shim to normalize embeddings before rerank and log a clear message during onboarding (emma), (4) add batch-idempotency header to embedding requests to avoid retry shape drift (omar).
josh: i'll open a revert PR and add a toggle flag `enable_shard_wire_format` behind an environment variable so we can test without breaking onboarding. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/495
maya: i'll add server validation and a small migration note in the API changelog.
omar: i'll implement idempotency on the server side and a client helper to compute per-batch sha256 keys.
ci-bot: :rocket: quick patch branch created: release/emb-shape-hotfix
emma: thanks all. i've updated the sampleapp README with a troubleshooting note: 'If rerank errors with dim mismatch, ensure you are running SDKs with compatible embedding wire format; use SAMPLEAPP_NORMALIZE=true to auto-normalize.'
josh: will run canary on staging in 10m. ping here with metrics.
emma: will watch staging, if errors fall below 1% i'll promote. closing for now unless new regressions show up. :pray:
